g.text: Separate approximation error from data-resampling instability
Left: 12 fixed company anchors, 16 fixed background rows, 3 explainer seeds; both methods satisfy local additivity.
Right: exact CIF Shapley values at 32 anchors under 8 common company bootstraps (28 dependent pairs); descriptive, not confidence intervals.
